## Rule

10×10 grid embedded top-left of a 30×30 one-hot frame. A **color-3 2×2 block** is the anchor. Every non-zero, non-3 **marker** that shares one of the block's 2 rows draws a horizontal ray of its own color from the block edge out to (and including) itself; every marker sharing one of the block's 2 columns draws a vertical ray. Off-axis markers and the block are preserved. Output is `[1,10,30,30]`, zeros outside the top-left 10×10.

## Algorithm sketch

Ray fill is a data-dependent *range* between block edge and marker → needs a betweenness relation (`≥` and `≠`), hence the "quadratic_relation" pairroute Einsum. See LIVE graph below.
